name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
purpose: Reveal or hide one supporting content region without leaving the current context, using an underline disclosure by default.
avoidFor: Content that must always be compared
accessibility: Uses a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The content region is labelled by its trigger.
Closed retained content is inert and hidden from assistive technology.
commonMistakes: Using Collapsible for a multi-item accordion.
Omitting a stable id or meaningful visible title.
Placing required task content only inside the closed region.
